name: Isotryptamine
summary: Isotryptamine, also known as 2-(1-indolyl)ethylamine, is a chemical compound and positional isomer of tryptamine (2-(3-indolyl)ethylamine). A variety of isotryptamine derivatives, or substituted isotryptamines, have been studied and described.
